axioms.name: Experimental.P06_02.inserted_geometric_integral_norm_summable
axioms.meaning: Absolute-integral summability of the actual extra geometric series.

literal_statement_repair_policy: No repair is silently substituted for the verbatim target.
coverage: Uses the verified density and moments directly; defines the exact lcm and inserted geometric-series terms. No simultaneous linear form evaluation or final denominator overhead is assumed.
remaining: Prove both prerequisites, establish the extra geometric expansion and interchange, derive the ζ(6) tail, expand integer polynomial coefficients, and clear the divided-difference denominators. The target formula for R_K is not an axiom.
